page_title: WHU 1-1 MNU | West Ham v Manchester Utd 10/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.

90+6' 1 - 1 Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the top right corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:1.
90+5' Callum Wilson (West Ham) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
90+4' Bruno Fernandes slings in a great lofted ball towards Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United), who doesn't get the best of contacts but still sends a close-range header inches wide of the left post.
90+3' West Ham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+2' What a great touch by Adama Traore (West Ham) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. West Ham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+2' West Ham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+1' Callum Wilson (West Ham) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adama Traore (West Ham) replacing Crysencio Summerville.
90' Substitution. Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jarrod Bowen walks off.
89' Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.

89' What a great touch by Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked. Manchester Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.
86' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Callum Wilson, but Senne Lammens displays great awareness to stop him.
85' A clumsy foul by Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) and Simon Hooper blows his whistle.
82' Casemiro (Manchester United) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
82' It is time for a substitution. Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) is on for Diogo Dalot.
82' Simon Hooper couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Tomas Soucek (West Ham) and blew his whistle.
80' Nuno Espirito Santo prepares a substitution. El Hadji Malick Diouf is replaced by Oliver Scarles (West Ham).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham) comes onto the pitch for Freddie Potts.
79' Casemiro (Manchester United) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
78' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) sends a long through ball to Bruno Fernandes, but he fails to control it properly and loses it to one of the defending players.
77' A flowing move ends with a great cross into the centre of the box, which Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) latches onto but sends a wild header well wide of the right post.

76' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Mads Hermansen shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
74' Casemiro (Manchester United) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
70' Simon Hooper shows the yellow card to Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) for a heavy challenge.
69' Substitution. Taty Castellanos makes his way off the pitch and Callum Wilson (West Ham) comes on as his replacement.
69' Michael Carrick has decided to substitute Matheus Cunha and he is replaced by Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United).
68' Substitution. Harry Maguire leaves the pitch and is replaced by Leny Yoro (Manchester United).
66' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
65' Good work from West Ham as they win a corner.
64' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Manchester Utd players look gutted.
63' The Manchester Utd players halt their celebrations as referee Simon Hooper makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
63' Goal! Kobbie Mainoo picks out Casemiro (Manchester United) with a perfect cross, and he has no problem to nod the ball into an empty net. It's 1:0.
62' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
60' Referee Simon Hooper sees the trip by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
59' Looks like Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
59' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
58' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
57' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) for his blatant foul.
56' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
55' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
54' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
53' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.

50' 1 - 0 Superb finishing from Tomas Soucek (West Ham). Jarrod Bowen plays a fantastic through ball and finds Tomas Soucek (West Ham), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goal and fire a low shot from close range past the goalkeeper. It's 1:0.
49' The ball is cleared after Amad Diallo (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
47' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mads Hermansen, who smothers the ball.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' That's it for today, Simon Hooper has blown his whistle and the game is over.
45' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
43' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from West Ham.
41' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but missed to the left of the target.
40' A crossfield pass from El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) fails to find any of his teammates.
37' The Manchester Utd players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
36' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a long ball in, but Mads Hermansen comfortably gathers the ball.
34' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) tries to find El Hadji Malick Diouf, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
32' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

31' Casemiro (Manchester United) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. West Ham win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
28' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but Mads Hermansen comes off his line to gather the ball.
27' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
26' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Luke Shaw (Manchester United).
24' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
23' The ball from the resulting corner kick slipped through the box to Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham), who instantly fires towards the right side of the net, but the effort is blocked. So unlucky.
22' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
22' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester Utd will have a corner.
21' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) tries to find Amad Diallo, but he puts too much power on the pass.
19' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
18' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) tackles a bit over-zealously and Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
17' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) wins the ball from the corner and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but it's a soft effort and drifts well past the left post.
16' The referee awards a corner and Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) goes over to take it.
16' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) tries to find Bruno Fernandes with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
15' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Simon Hooper signals.
13' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

13' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the right side of the goal, but Senne Lammens made a superb athletic save to deny him. Corner kick. West Ham will have an opportunity.
12' Senne Lammens (Manchester United) takes a direct free kick.
10' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

9' Chance! Crysencio Summerville sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Jarrod Bowen (West Ham), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
8' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
5' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) will take a corner kick.
5' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out for a corner. West Ham can continue in their attacking effort.
3' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) but poses no threat.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Manchester Utd will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Simon Hooper.
